title: estate.survey — input
description: Selects the scope to survey. An absent scope means the whole estate visible to this machine.

value.description: Required for kind=owner (an org login) and kind=project (a project: id). Ignored for kind=estate.

includeExternal.description: Include repositories owned by third parties that are merely cloned here.

asOfScanId.description: The requested comparison scan. Historical registry snapshots are not implemented: answers use the current registry and report a different requested scan in degraded. scanId identifies the scan represented by the answer.

limit.description: Return at most this many projects. Omit for all projects. No implicit page limit is applied, preserving existing callers; pagination fields describe any omitted results.

cursor.description: Continue after the project id returned as nextCursor. Projects are ordered by id. Registry changes between requests may affect pagination; historical scan pinning is not implemented.
